content.title: Structural engineering services
content.intro: Fast, accurate, permit-ready plans for homes, low-rise commercial buildings and glazing systems.

photo.alt: An engineer in a hard hat points at a floor plan pinned to a concrete column inside an unfinished building.

items.title: Residential structural design
items.body: Custom homes, remodels and additions, decks, foundations, retaining walls, lateral checks.

items.title: Low-rise commercial
items.body: Small retail and office, tenant improvement scopes, framing and lateral design, connection details, permit coordination.

items.title: Glazing and mullion engineering
items.body: Storefronts, mullion spans and deflection, anchorage, thermal movement; shop drawings and calculations.

content.heading: Who we serve
items: Architects looking for coordinated structural sets that fit the design intent.
Homeowners who need reliable engineering for remodels, additions or new homes.
Builders and contractors who value quick responses, clear drawings and practical field solutions.
Developers managing several projects who need efficient, repeatable design support.
Glazing and storefront contractors who need accurate, code-compliant calculations and anchor details.
Owners and facility managers looking for structural evaluations, letters or retrofit recommendations.

content.heading: Tools and codes
content.body: All work is produced in AutoCAD and Revit for clean coordination with architects and general contractors. We design to IBC and ASCE 7 loads, verify glass strength with ASTM E1300, size aluminum members per the Aluminum Design Manual, and design anchorage with AISC and ACI, as the project and jurisdiction require.

steps.title: Share your plans
steps.body: Send drawings, sketches or site photos. We review the scope, ask the right questions and outline what a permit-ready package needs.

steps.title: Scope and quote in 48 hours
steps.body: Within two business days you get a clear proposal with deliverables, pricing and schedule.

steps.title: Design and analysis
steps.body: All calculations and drawings in AutoCAD or Revit, coordinated with your architect or contractor.

steps.title: Review and revisions
steps.body: Every design is checked for code compliance and constructability, and adjusted quickly with your team.

steps.title: Permit-ready package
steps.body: Sealed drawings and calculations, organized, labeled and ready to submit.

steps.title: Support through approval
steps.body: We stay available for plan check comments and revisions so your schedule holds.

where.heading: Where we work
where.body: Currently serving Colorado. Need help in another state? We'll get licensed quickly and handle local requirements so your schedule stays intact.

items.question: What do you need to start?
items.answer: System type, elevations and spans, project location or design pressures, substrate details, and any specified deflection or drift limits.

items.question: Can you establish design pressures?
items.answer: Yes. If needed, we calculate pressures per ASCE 7 from the project geometry and exposure; otherwise we design to the values provided.

items.question: Do you check glass thickness and layups?
items.answer: Yes, per ASTM E1300 and the project specifications, including special cases like guards and impact glazing.

items.question: Do you stamp drawings?
items.answer: We stamp calculations and drawings in Colorado. For other states, we'll arrange licensure on request.

items.question: How fast is delivery?
items.answer: We guarantee a 48-hour response and offer expedited schedules depending on scope.

content.heading: Ready to get started?
content.body: Quick replies, clean drawings, and fair pricing.
